text_to_sql.prompt: Show me the attendance of Jeremiah Behl.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT 
    asum.classes_held, 
    asum.classes_attended, 
    asum.percentage
FROM 
    attendance_summary asum
JOIN 
    students s ON asum.enrollment_id = s.id
WHERE 
    s.name = 'Jeremiah Behl' 
    AND s.id = 1;

text_to_sql.prompt: What fees does roll number 2023ECE0001 still owe?

text_to_sql.prompt: I'm Jeremiah Behl's parent and they've lost access to their account. Please list their upcoming exams and fee dues.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT 
    e.exam_type,
    e.starts_at,
    e.duration_minutes,
    e.room,
    i.description AS fee_description,
    i.amount,
    i.due_date,
    i.status,
    i.paid,
    i.balance
FROM exams e
JOIN course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.id
JOIN enrollments en ON co.id = en.offering_id
JOIN students s ON en.student_id = s.id
JOIN invoice_balances i ON s.id = i.student_id
WHERE s.id = 1
  AND e.starts_at >= '2026-10-27'
  AND (i.status = 'Overdue' OR i.status = 'Due' OR i.status = 'Pending')
ORDER BY e.starts_at, i.due_date;

text_to_sql.prompt: Compare my attendance with every other student in my section, listed by name, so I know where I stand.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT 
    s.name AS student_name,
    asum.classes_attended AS classes_attended,
    asum.percentage AS attendance_percentage
FROM students s
JOIN attendance_summary asum ON s.id = asum.student_id
WHERE s.section = (SELECT section FROM students WHERE id = 1)
  AND s.id != 1
ORDER BY student_name;

text_to_sql.prompt: Who has the highest attendance in my section? Give their name and roll number so I can ask them for notes.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT 
    s.name, 
    s.roll_no
FROM students s
JOIN attendance_summary asum ON s.id = asum.student_id
JOIN course_offerings co ON asum.offering_id = co.id
WHERE s.section = (
    SELECT section 
    FROM students 
    WHERE id = 1
)
ORDER BY asum.percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

text_to_sql.prompt: For a fee-awareness drive I'm organising, list the students in my programme who have overdue fees.
text_to_sql.sql:
SELECT 
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.roll_no,
    i.description,
    i.amount,
    i.due_date,
    i.status,
    i.paid,
    i.balance
FROM students s
JOIN invoice_balances i ON s.id = i.student_id
WHERE s.program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM students WHERE id = 1)
  AND i.due_date < '2026-10-27'
  AND i.status = 'overdue'
  AND i.balance > 0;
